headline: High Airfares May Persist Despite Potential Resolution of Middle East Conflict
summary: Airlines state that ticket prices, which jumped after fuel costs spiked due to the war with Iran, will not return down quickly even if the conflict ends.
why: Jet fuel represents one of the largest variable operating expenses for commercial airlines, directly impacting carrier profitability and passenger ticket pricing structures.

impacts.name: Airlines
impacts.why: Airlines maintain elevated ticket prices to preserve margins following historical fuel cost spikes.
